controls: A hashed WAV fixture is uploaded and ingested through the actual API and worker path.
The explicitly synthetic replay is preserved in transcript provenance and is not labeled real ASR inference.
Clinician review, evidence-backed extraction, deterministic draft, verification, approval and exact JSON export are exercised in one transaction.
Export SHA-256, approved note digest, approval identity and source transcript version are cross-checked.
Failure forks are covered by existing withdrawal-during-inference, failed-adapter, invalid-output, stale-approval, tenant-isolation, upload-integrity and export-safety tests.
